issue.title: Isolate model-alias tests from parallel state leakage
issue.description: Discovered in an unrelated refactor verification run with SASE_PYTEST_EXCLUDE_VISUAL=1 just test. Fourteen llm_provider alias tests failed on the same xdist worker because coder aliases resolved to the ambient sonnet configuration; representative failures pass when rerun in isolation. Ensure model-alias/config caches and environment overrides are reset between tests so the parallel suite is order-independent.

payload.entry: Verified the inherited-launch regression with SASE_MODEL_ALIAS_OVERRIDES={coder:sonnet}: all 432 tests/llm_provider tests pass after isolation (15 failed before the fix). The post-fix 17-worker non-visual suite had 24,394 passes and no model-alias failures; its sole failure is the unrelated Spark label mismatch tracked in sase-bs. just check passed formatting, keep-sorted, Ruff, mypy, pyscripts, and changelog before the unrelated stale Symvision exemptions tracked in sase-bu; toobig and committed-plan validation also pass. SASE validation's unrelated plan-link failure belongs to active epic sase-bj.

Verified ambient SASE_MODEL_ALIAS_OVERRIDES isolation: 432 llm_provider tests passed under adversarial coder=sonnet override; full non-visual suite reached 24,394 passes with only unrelated sase-bs failure; just check passed through keep-sorted and was blocked only by separately tracked pre-existing validation issues.
